title: Sum of Squares of Special Elements
summary: Given an integer array nums of length n, find the sum of squares of elements where the index divides the length of the array.
statement: Given an integer array nums of length n, find the sum of squares of elements where the index divides the length of the array. For each i where n % i == 0, compute nums[i]^2 and sum these values.
constraints: A position i is special when the array length is divisible by i.
Return the sum of squares of values at special positions.
hints: Square and add exactly when the remainder is zero.
The divisibility condition independently classifies every position, so direct filtering is complete.
editorial: The divisibility condition independently classifies every position, so direct filtering is complete.

tests.explanation: Positions one, two, and four divide length four, contributing 1+4+16=21.
Positions one and three divide length three, contributing four and one.
